correctness.rationale: Exact adjacency projector tables derived using strongly-regular graph common-neighbor counts give 3+2 active spectral modes for all n>=5. The rank-one integrated Lyapunov identity is derived for arbitrary positive weights and applied to each sector; its four simplified rational coefficients are verified symbolically. The optimal placement sign is certified by a degree-13 polynomial with all-positive coefficients after shifting n by 7 plus exact n=5,6 cases. The fixed-rate comparison uses exact signs of a,b differences and two exact rate crossings. Reconstructed T_n adjacency simulations for n=5..9 independently reproduce 30 reduced physical Lyapunov lifetimes. Proof is infinite-family algebra, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: A complete natural absorber-placement phase classification on an infinite sequence of line graphs: the two geometries have exactly equal capture fraction but sharply different optimized conditional time, reversing at the small nontrivial integer threshold n=7. Exact fixed-rate crossover thresholds at n=6,7 add a directly interpretable transport-design boundary; neither an arbitrary slice nor a merely recomputed spectral rank. It demonstrates that eventual efficiency and fastest capture are distinct physically meaningful objectives.
